CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.variant_watch_baseline(_variant_id uuid)
 RETURNS smallint
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT (5 + (('x' || substr(md5(_variant_id::text), 1, 8))::bit(32)::bigint % 36))::smallint
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.flag_import_seller_edit()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL THEN
 UPDATE public.fb_marketplace_import_items i SET seller_edited=true
 FROM public.asks a WHERE i.listing_id=a.id AND a.seller_id=auth.uid()
 AND ((TG_TABLE_NAME='asks' AND a.id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'id')::uuid) OR (TG_TABLE_NAME='products' AND a.product_id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'id')::uuid) OR (TG_TABLE_NAME='classified_listing_details' AND a.id=(to_jsonb(NEW)->>'listing_id')::uuid));
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER managed_product_edit AFTER UPDATE ON products FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION flag_import_seller_edit()
